skill.name: softsync-meetings
skill.description: Find calendar events, and manage booking pages: free times, bookings, booking a meeting for someone, rescheduling and cancelling. Use when the user asks when they meet someone, or wants to book, move or cancel a meeting.
skill.summary: Find calendar events, and manage booking pages: free times, bookings, booking a meeting for someone,...

security_audit.summary: All 19 external-command detections are false positives because the backticked terms are API tool names and action labels in Markdown, not shell execution. The two system-reconnaissance detections are also false positives because they describe authorized calendar and contact lookups required by the meeting workflow. No prompt injection or other net-new malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: Backticked API tool names may be mistaken for shell execution.
remediation.suggestion: Document that the backticked names are connected API operations, and keep their accepted actions and parameters explicit.

remediation.issue: Calendar and booking mutations can send invitations or affect other attendees.
remediation.suggestion: Retain the requirement to state who, when, and what will change, then obtain clear user confirmation before booking, rescheduling, cancelling, or changing settings.

content.value_statement: Meeting coordination often requires checking calendars, finding availability, and managing booking changes across several workflows. This skill guides calendar and booking-page operations with clear attendee, timing, and confirmation requirements.
actual_capabilities: List calendar events within a specified ISO 8601 time window.
Search events by company, contact, title, or description.
Review event attendees, video links, linked records, and event messages.
List meeting types and find available booking slots for up to 31 days.
Book, reschedule, cancel, reassign, or update meeting bookings with required details.
Manage booking-page settings, meeting types, reminders, sessions, and availability.
limitations: The skill requires connected calendar or mailbox access for calendar operations.
It does not provide recorded meeting summaries as calendar events.
Availability searches cover a window of up to 31 days.
Booking changes can send invitations or notifications to real people.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Client Meetings
use_cases.description: Find past or upcoming client meetings, review attendees, and identify suitable booking times before sending an invitation.

use_cases.title: Manage Team Booking Pages
use_cases.description: Review meeting types, availability, reminders, hosts, and sessions while maintaining consistent booking-page settings.

use_cases.title: Handle Meeting Changes
use_cases.description: Reschedule, cancel, reassign, or update bookings while clearly stating the affected people, time, and action.

prompt_templates.title: Find This Week's Meetings
prompt_templates.prompt: List my meetings for this week in my time zone. Show the start time, attendees, video link, and linked company or contact.

prompt_templates.title: Find Client Availability
prompt_templates.prompt: Find available slots for a 30-minute meeting with Acme next week. Use the client's linked record and show times in my time zone.

prompt_templates.title: Book a Meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Book the earliest available slot for Jordan Lee using the selected meeting type. Confirm the time zone, guest email, and required guest answers before booking.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Booking Settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the booking page, hosts, reminders, event sessions, and shared availability. Identify changes needed, then ask for confirmation before applying them.

output_examples.input: What meetings do I have with Acme this week?
output_examples.output: Three meetings found in your time zone: a Tuesday kickoff, a Thursday review, and a Friday planning session. Each result includes attendees, the video link, and the linked Acme record.

output_examples.input: Find a slot for a 30-minute consultation next week.
Move the customer call to the next available time.
output_examples.output: The booking can move to Wednesday at 2:00 PM Pacific. The guest and current host will receive an updated invitation after your confirmation.

best_practices: State the people, date, time zone, and requested action before changing a booking.
Check available slots before booking or rescheduling a meeting.
Ask for clear confirmation before sending invitations, notifications, or cancellations.
anti_patterns: Do not book or reschedule a meeting without confirming the guest, time, and time zone.
Do not cancel an event session without warning that every guest may be affected.
Do not update a meeting type without reading its current hosts, questions, and other lists.

faq.question: What calendars can this skill use?
faq.answer: It can use calendars connected through a mailbox, including synced Google and Outlook calendar events.

faq.question: Can it find meetings with a specific company?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search for the company or contact, then use the linked record to find related calendar events.

faq.question: How far ahead can it search for booking slots?
faq.answer: The booking-slot workflow supports a window of up to 31 days.

faq.question: Can it book a meeting for another person?
faq.answer: Yes. It can book for a guest when a free start time, guest details, and required answers are available.

faq.question: Can it manage booking-page administration?
faq.answer: Yes. An administrator can manage meeting types, reminders, sessions, hosts, booking settings, and availability.

faq.question: Will meeting changes notify people?
faq.answer: Booking, rescheduling, and cancellation can send invitations or emails. The workflow requires clear confirmation before these actions.
